risks.risk: Exact make/model and variant are not readable, so the correct market comparables and parts availability can’t be confirmed.

risks.risk: Odometer/mileage and real usage are unknown; age claim may be inaccurate.

risks.risk: Mechanical condition (engine start, clutch/gear shifting, brakes, suspension) can’t be verified from a single exterior photo.
risks.proof: Short video clip of a cold start + 30–60 seconds of riding, and a close-up of brake levers/discs/drums.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified mechanically (assume possible servicing needed).

risks.risk: Tire condition and possible hidden damage (frame alignment, bent forks, electrical faults) are not confirmable.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tires (tread depth), front fork alignment, and both sides of the bike.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average wear with potential minor repairs.
